decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the task completion schedule and clock-out target. The instruction to ensure information is stored before clock-out belongs to the separate artifact-submission Requirement and does not require another candidate-state change.
The source sets task timing and an artifact-readiness deadline but does not change the fallback rule for independently selecting work when an assignment is unavailable.
The source does not mention marking tasks complete in ClickUp or otherwise change the candidate's task-status rule.
The surrounding exchange concerns Pinterest Tasks 1 and 2. It does not change the completed CRM document's expected result or storage location.
